publicPreviewSummary: Learn to write effective AI prompts, improve responses and check AI-generated results for accuracy.
capstone: A five-prompt reusable toolkit with synthetic test inputs, comparison outputs, source verification and error log

modules.learningObjective: Write clear task prompts with audience, goal, context, and safe output boundaries
levelTitles: What Problem Should a Prompt Solve
Distinguish an Instruction from Context
Specify the Audience and Desired Outcome
Describe the Input Without Exposing Secrets
Choose a Useful Answer Format
Checkpoint: Rewrite a Vague Study Prompt
modules.exampleScenario: Specify the Audience and Desired Outcome

modules.learningObjective: Improve under-specified instructions with grounded examples and explicit conditions
levelTitles: Add Relevant Constraints and Examples
Separate Must-Have from Optional Conditions
Ask a Focused Follow-Up for Missing Details
Compare Two Prompt Strategies Fairly
Revise After an Incomplete First Response
Checkpoint: Build a Reusable Prompt Template
modules.exampleScenario: Ask a Focused Follow-Up for Missing Details

modules.learningObjective: Independently verify calculations, sources, claims, and private information
levelTitles: Spot a Confident but Unsupported AI Claim
Trace a Source Back to Its Origin
Verify Simple AI-Generated Calculations
Recognize Sensitive Data in Prompts
Explain Model Uncertainty to a Reader
Checkpoint: Audit an AI-Generated Summary

modules.learningObjective: Test a reusable prompt collection on synthetic realistic tasks and explain its limitations
levelTitles: Select Five Realistic Everyday Prompt Tasks
Write Acceptance Criteria for Each Output
Create Synthetic Inputs for Safe Testing
Collect Errors and Corrective Prompt Changes
Document Limitations and Human Review
Capstone: Deliver a Verified Prompt Toolkit
modules.exampleScenario: Create Synthetic Inputs for Safe Testing
